_note: The content `conveyor admin install` puts into a fresh tenant beyond the catalogue and the default process catalogue. `knowledge` is empty at this baseline: no knowledge pack exists in the seed (a tenant's packs are imported from its own documents in the ingestion tranches), so binding one would be a dangling reference. A tenant with no pack is a valid tenant. The three schedules are the engine's own housekeeping kinds, copied from the live tenant (measured 2026-11-20).
